title: Streak of daily activity
statementMd:
For account 3, group distinct transaction days into runs of consecutive calendar days and show the longest run length in days as `longest_streak`.

Expected columns: `longest_streak`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Subtract a row number from the day number to identify islands.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx_date FROM transactions WHERE account_id = 3), g AS (SELECT CAST(julianday(tx_date) AS INTEGER) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tx_date) AS grp FROM d) SELECT MAX(c) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM g GROUP BY grp);
```
